answer: Make every agent prove useful work before it can earn, and let peers verify that work on an open ledger. A Sybil attacker then faces a steep horizon: each fake identity needs its own history of real contributions, so a thousand clones cost a thousand times the effort. No island of bots can fake that history for each other, because attestations only count when they come from independent agents with their own track records. Cross-checking work across the ridge of unrelated verifiers makes cheap identity spam unprofitable, while honest newcomers can still join by doing real work.
